content: Submit daily tasks via the v2-tasks page. Earn coins for Daily Job Posting every day.
Mark attendance in your student dashboard. WhatsApp Re-Joiners must fill Google Form twice daily.
2-step approval: Coordinator approves first, then HR. LOC at 100% completion, LOR at 50%+, Star Performance for top scorers.
Upload Address Proof and Marksheet at my-documents page. Accepted: PDF/JPG/PNG under 5MB.
Offer letter generated after HR approves your uploaded documents. Auto-generated after 24hr delay.
View your registration details including your password (masked) in the Profile modal on your dashboard.
Join TEN alumni Discord: https://discord.gg/GYnZFbDE7. Find the QR code in the attendance section.
Login with your Employee ID and the password you registered with at the login page.
Select New Joiner or WhatsApp Re-Joiner on first login. This cannot be changed later.
Available domains: Web Dev, Python, AI, Data Science, MERN, HR Management, Java, Flutter, Cyber Security, DevOps, Software Engineering.
Earn coins by completing daily tasks. Coins are tracked on your dashboard.
Your coordinator manages your tasks and approvals. Contact them via the Domain Chat feature.
Standard internship is 45 days. Certificate issued after completion and HR approval.
If you have payment queries, check the Payment section in your dashboard or contact HR.
